title: 50th Anniversary of the World Food Programme

obverse.description: A globe bearing the World Food Programme inscription, accompanied by ears of wheat, maize, and rice. The design also includes the Italian Republic monogram, the Rome mint mark, and the year 2004.

title: 75th Anniversary of the Founding of Vatican City State

obverse.description: A schematic view of the Vatican City walls and St Peter's Basilica, surrounded by anniversary dates and inscriptions marking 75 years since the state's founding.

obverse.description: A bust of historian and numismatist Bartolomeo Borghesi, encircled by the twelve stars of the European Union, his name, San Marino, and the year 2004.

title: Effigy and Monogram of Grand Duke Henri

obverse.description: Grand Duke Henri's right-facing portrait appears beside his crowned monogram. The surrounding inscriptions include Luxembourg's name, his title, the year 2004, mint marks, and twelve stars.

title: Enlargement of the European Union by Ten New Member States

obverse.description: A stylised pillar supports upward-growing shoots, symbolising the European Union's enlargement and its foundation for growth. The design includes the letters EU, the year 2004, and twelve stars.
